meta.title: Mightling — mai taimakon rubuta lambar kwamfuta da ke aiki a na'urar da ke kan teburinka
meta.description: Mai taimakon rubuta lambar kwamfuta da ke aiki a kan NVIDIA DGX Spark guda, kuma ba ya aika komai waje. A gwajin matsalolin shirye-shirye 100 na gaske, ya warware 68, da gudun kusan token 48 (gutsuttsuran kalma) a daƙiƙa. Babu cloud, babu asusu, babu kuɗi a kowane amfani, babu bin diddigi.
meta.og_title: Mightling — mai taimakon rubuta lambar kwamfuta da ke aiki a na'urar da ke kan teburinka. An warware matsalolin gwaji 68 cikin 100.
meta.og_description: Ya warware matsalolin shirye-shirye na gaske 68 cikin 100 na SWE-bench Verified, a kan DGX Spark guda ba tare da buƙatar hanyar sadarwa ba, da gudun kusan token 48 a daƙiƙa. Babu cloud, babu asusu, babu kuɗi a kowane amfani, babu bin diddigi.
install.h101:
Mai taimakon rubuta lambar kwamfuta da ke aiki a cikin na'urarka.
Ya warware kusan 69 cikin kowace matsalolin gwaji 100.
install.p02: Matsalolin shirye-shirye na gaske 68 cikin 100 na SWE-bench Verified, an warware su ba tare da intanet ba a kan DGX Spark guda, da gudun kusan token 48 a daƙiƙa. (Token ƙaramin gutsurar kalma ne; na'urar tana rubuta kusan 48 daga cikinsu a kowace daƙiƙa.) Mightling mai taimakon rubuta lambar kwamfuta ne, kuma mataimakin hira ne, kuma manhajar tebur ce, kuma duk yana aiki a cikin GB10 naka. Ba a aika komai zuwa cloud ba. Babu asusu, babu kuɗi a kowane amfani, babu bin diddigi. Yadda muka auna shi
install.span04: # yana sauke samfurin sau ɗaya (~20 GB), sannan ya fara shi
install.p06: Wannan yana aiki a kan NVIDIA DGX Spark da kuma kowace na'urar GB10 ta daban. Rubutun yana duba kowane saukarwa da checksums na fitowar, kuma yana nuna maka kowane umarnin sudo kafin ya gudanar da shi. Za ka iya karanta rubutun tukuna.
install.p08: Sauran kwamfutocinka suna aron samfurin GB10 ta hanyar sadarwar gidanka ko ofishinka. A Mac ko wata na'urar Linux, umarni ɗaya yana sanya ling, wato ɓangaren da kake rubutu a ciki. Yana samun GB10 da kansa.
install.p09: Daga 1.7.2 yana kuma sanya manhajar tebur a Applications a kan Mac, a shirye don buɗewa. Ƙara --no-app idan ba ka so.
install.p12: Rubuta wannan a PowerShell. Ba ya buƙatar haƙƙin mai gudanarwa (daga 1.7.2 haka ma manhajar tebur). Sai Windows ya tambaye ka sau ɗaya ka kafa wuri mai bango inda mai taimakon yake gudanar da umarni. Ba a sa wa mai shigarwar hannu tukuna ba, don haka dole a kashe Smart App Control. Karanta rubutun.
install.span13: matsalolin SWE-bench Verified da aka warware, ba tare da intanet ba, a kan DGX Spark guda
install.span14: kalmomi a daƙiƙa yayin da yake aiki a kan lambar kwamfuta, aiki ɗaya a lokaci guda
install.span15: haɗin da ke tuntuɓar waje, da binciken egress ya duba
install.span16: a kowane token, muddin kana amfani da shi
new.h201: Sabo a 1.7: manhajar desktop a kan Mac, Linux da Windows
new.p02: Manhajar tebur ta 1.7.0 tana haɗa hanyoyin amfani da Mightling biyu a taga ɗaya: Ask, inda kake yin tambayoyi, da Work, inda mai taimakon yake gyara lambar kwamfutarka. Work yana da akwati na rubuta ayyuka (za ka iya haɗa fayiloli, skills da umarni), da faifai don duba canje-canje kafin ka riƙe ko ka soke su, da kwafin aiki daban-daban na lambar kwamfutarka (worktrees), da shafukan tasha, da itacen fayiloli kusa da tattaunawar. A sauran kwamfutocinka, manhajar tana magana da GB10 naka, wanda take samu a hanyar sadarwarka.
new.p04: Daga 1.7.2, umarnin shigarwa yana sanya Mightling a Applications kusa da ling, kuma ka buɗe shi kamar kowace manhaja. Yana aiki a kan Apple silicon da Intel, da macOS 12 ko sabo. ling update yana sabunta shi.
new.p06: A kan GB10, fayil ɗin mightling_1.7.0_arm64.deb yana shigar da manhajar, da shigarwarta a menu, da umarnin ling-app, tare da bayanin sandbox da take buƙata. (Sandbox ɗaki ne a rufe don gudanar da umarni, don kada su taɓa sauran na'urar.)
new.p07: Sai ka buɗe ta daga menu na manhajoji, ko ka rubuta ling app. Ƙari.
new.p09: Daga 1.7.2, layin PowerShell yana sanya manhajar ma, a gare ka kaɗai kuma ba tare da haƙƙin mai gudanarwa ba, da shigarwa a menu na Start. Settings → Apps yana cire ta, kuma ling update yana sabunta ta. Dole a kashe Smart App Control.
new.p11: Shafin fitowar yana kuma da hoton diski na Mac (Mightling-<version>-arm64-preview.dmg, ko x64 don Intel) da mai shigar da Windows (Mightling-Setup-<version>-x64.exe, ko arm64). Samfuran gwaji ne marasa sa hannu, don haka idan ka sauke su a burauza, tsarinka yana tsayar da su a karon farko. Kafin ka buɗe ɗaya, duba shi da fayil ɗin SHA256SUMS mai sa hannu na fitowar.
new.li12: macOS 15 da sabo: ja Mightling zuwa Applications ka buɗe shi sau ɗaya. Sai ka je System Settings › Privacy & Security ka danna Open Anyway. A macOS 14 da tsoho, danna manhajar tare da Control ka zaɓi Open.
new.li13: Windows: SmartScreen › More info › Run anyway. Dole a kashe Smart App Control.
new.p14: Haka kuma a 1.7.0: Night Shift na iya gwada aiki ɗaya sau da yawa ya riƙe mafi kyawun gwaji (/night add --best-of N). Na'ura ɗaya na iya gudanar da gadoji na Signal da yawa. Kuma kwamfutar da ke ganin GB10 biyu a hanyar sadarwa ɗaya na iya zaɓar tsakaninsu ba tare da manta wanda ta riga ta sani ba. Bayanan fitowa da saukarwa.
benchmark.h201: SWE-bench Verified, an auna a kan DGX Spark guda
benchmark.p02: SWE-bench Verified tarin matsaloli 500 ne na gaske da aka ɗauko daga shirye-shiryen buɗaɗɗen tushe. A kowace ɗaya, dole mai taimakon ya canza lambar kwamfuta har gwaje-gwajen su ci. A 2026-10-08 mun ba Mightling 1.5.1 guda 100 daga cikinsu, da samfurin Qwen3.8-27B, a kan DGX Spark guda ba tare da intanet ba. Ya yi ƙoƙari ɗaya a kowace, a yanayinsa na asali, kuma ya warware 68 cikin 100. Idan muka faɗaɗa wannan zuwa 500 duka, kimarmu kusan 69% ce, da ƙarin ko ragi na maki kaɗan (kewayon 95% daga 63.9 zuwa 73.4% ne). Mun auna wannan da kanmu, a na'urarmu, a kan samfurin matsalolin. Ba shigarwa ba ce a hukumar jerin sunayen shugabanni.

benchmark.p29: Karanta wannan tebur a matsayin hanyar ganin wanda ke kusa, ba a matsayin jeri ba. A kan matsaloli 100 iri ɗaya, Mightling ya warware daidai da Qwen3-Coder-480B da GLM-4.6, samfura da suka fi shi girma sau da yawa. Amma kowane layi yana amfani da wani shirin mai taimako da wata na'ura daban, kuma layukan jerin shugabanni sun yi amfani da hotunan gwaji na hukuma don kwamfutocin x86, yayin da namu ya yi aiki a kan hotunan al'umma don arm64. Akwai kuma wani yanayi na biyu, mai suna refine. Zama na farko yana nazarin matsalar bai canza komai ba, sannan sabon zama ya yi aikin. Ya warware matsala ɗaya fiye da na asali (69 da 68, kuma kowane yanayi ya warware wasu da ɗayan ya rasa), kuma ya ɗauki kusan sau 2.2 na lokaci a kowace matsala. Don haka a kashe yake sai ka nema da ling --refine.
benchmark.p31: Matsaloli 100 kashi ɗaya cikin biyar ne na Verified, don haka lambar 500 duka kiyasi ce. Ga yadda muka yi ta. Ɗauki sakamakon dukan abubuwan da aka miƙa 175 na Verified a fili, matsala bayan matsala. Ba kowace matsala wahala, ba kowane tsari iyawa, da samfurin item-response (Rasch) mai sigogi ɗaya. Iyawar Mightling ita ce wadda za ta warware 68 a cikin waɗannan matsaloli 100, kuma kusan 69% shi ne abin da wannan iyawar za ta samu a 500 duka. Regression mai sauƙi a kan makin da aka buga yana yarda a cikin maki ɗaya. Mun kuma gwada hanyar a kan wasu: ga kowane abin da aka miƙa a fili, mun yi amfani da makinsa a kan waɗannan matsaloli 100 kaɗai don hasashen makinsa a 500 duka. Kuskuren ya kasance maki 2.4 (RMSE), kuma kewayon da ke sama sau 1.96 ne na wannan a kowane gefe. Za a iya sake samun kowace lamba a cikin tebur ta scripts/swe_bench_compare.py, daga bayanan kowace matsala na jama'a a SWE-bench/experiments.
benchmark.p32: Mun raba matsaloli 100 a tsakanin shirye-shiryen da ke cikin Verified da adadi ɗaya da na cikakken tarin. Mun zaɓe su daga matsalolin da shirin gwajinsu ke aiki kuma ya tabbata a arm64 (gyaran da ya dace yana cin gwajin, rashin yin komai kuma yana faɗuwa). Tsare-tsaren da aka buga suna samun maki 1.0 zuwa 1.5 ƙasa a kan waɗannan 100 fiye da 500 duka, don haka samfurin ba mai sauƙi ba ne. Duk da haka ba shigarwa ba ce a jerin shugabanni, domin ƙungiyar SWE-bench ce ke tantance su a na'urorinsu.

try.p02: Ko ka bar aiki na yau da dare da /night add <task>. Mightling yana bi ta jerin yayin da kake barci, kowane aiki a reshen git nasa, kuma da safe ka duba rassan.
proof.h201: Lambar kwamfutarka tana kan teburinka, kuma za ka iya tabbatar da haka
proof.p02: Mai taimakon rubuta lambar kwamfuta na cloud yana aika lambar kwamfutarka zuwa kwamfutocin da na wani ne. Mightling ba ya aika ta ko'ina. Samfurin yana aiki a GB10 naka, kuma babu komai a Mightling da ke tuntuɓar waje: babu ƙidayar amfani, babu auna, babu shiga, ko rahotannin rushewa na "ɓoyayye". Don haka za ka iya amfani da shi a kan lambar da ba a yarda ka ɗora ba, kamar aikin abokin ciniki, ko bayanai masu kariya, ko samfurin da ba a fitar ba tukuna.
proof.p03: Umarni ɗaya yana gudanar da zaman Mightling na gaske a ƙarƙashin strace, kayan aikin da ke kallon kowace kira da shiri ke yi, sannan ya jera kowane haɗin hanyar sadarwa da zaman ya buɗe:
proof.p04: Duka sun tsaya a 127.0.0.1, wato na'urar tana magana da kanta. Ba a yi ko binciken DNS ɗaya ba (binciken DNS shi ne tambayar intanet adireshin wani suna).
proof.p06: Rubuta /airgapped on. Kowane umarni da mai taimakon ya gudanar zai sami hanyar sadarwa maras komai daga kernel na Linux. Ba roƙo mai ladabi ga samfurin ba ne. Kawai babu hanyar sadarwa da za a kai. A lokaci guda, Full Access, wanda zai kewaye sandbox, ana ƙi shi.
proof.h307: Me zai iya fita, kuma yaushe
proof.p08: Abin da kai ko mai taimakon ya nema kawai: binciken yanar gizo (ta hanyar SearXNG na sirri da ke aiki a na'urarka, ko da yake binciken kansa yana fita zuwa yanar gizo), ɗauko shafin yanar gizo, buƙatar karatu kawai zuwa asusun Google da ka haɗa, ko duba sabuntawa. Da /airgapped on, babu ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan da ke faruwa.
why.p03: Samfurin, lambar kwamfutarka, tambayoyinka da amsoshinsa suna zama a na'urar da suke.
why.li05: Binciken egress da za ka iya sake yi
why.p14: Waɗannan gudun aiki ɗaya ne a lokaci guda a kan GB10. Samfurin yana amfani da dabara mai suna speculative decoding: ƙaramin mataimaki yana hasashen kalmomi da yawa gaba, sannan babban samfurin yana duba duk hasashen a lokaci guda. "Aiki a kan lambar kwamfuta" an auna shi a zaman masu taimako na gaske. Rubuta lambar kwamfuta, JSON da rubutu kowanne an auna a kan irin wannan fitarwa. Layin ƙarshe shi ne yawan rubutun da zai iya riƙewa a zuciya lokaci guda, token 262K, wato 'yan shafuka ɗari. Gudanar da masu taimako huɗu a lokaci guda idan kana so. Babu ƙima, babu "don Allah a jira".
why.li16: Babu gyara: mun zaɓi samfurin, girman ƙwaƙwalwa, lambar ƙasa da speculative decoding don GB10.
why.li17: Bai kamata ya daskarar da na'urarka ba: yana duba na'urar kafin ya loda samfurin, kuma yana sa ido a kan ƙwaƙwalwa yayin loda.
why.li18: Sauran kwamfutocinka suna samunsa a hanyar sadarwarka.
features.h302: 🖥️ ling, mai taimakon da ke cikin tashar ka
features.p03: Yana karanta aikinka, yana gudanar da umarni da gwaje-gwaje, yana gyara lambar kwamfuta, kuma yana tambayarka tukuna kafin duk wani abu mai haɗari.
features.p05: Rubuta /night add <task> kafin barci. Da safe kowane aiki ya kammala a reshen git nasa. Ba a haɗa ko a tura komai sai ka yi da kanka.
features.h306: 🔎 Binciken yanar gizo da ɗauko shafi
features.p07: Bincike yana wucewa ta SearXNG na sirri a na'urarka, don haka babu asusun bincike kuma babu maɓallin da za a nema. Tambayoyin suna dai fita zuwa yanar gizo don a amsa su.
features.p09: Jerin inda aka ayyana abubuwa da wanda ke amfani da su a ko'ina cikin aikinka, don mai taimakon ya iya duba lambar kwamfuta ba sai ya nemo ta ta hasashe ba.
features.h310: 🧩 Skills da kake da su tuni
features.p11: Skills da ka rubuta don Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw ko Hermes suna aiki a nan yadda suke.
features.p13: Tambayoyi da binciken yanar gizo, binciken hoto da magana maimakon rubutu, da zaman masu taimakonka ma, daga wannan na'ura ko daga wayar da ka haɗa da ita. Duk yana amfani da samfurin nan ɗaya a na'urarka.
features.p15: Ask da Work a taga ɗaya, a GB10, Mac, Linux ko Windows. Zaman mai taimakon yana neman amincewarka, kuma akwai faifai don duba canje-canje, kwafin aiki daban-daban, da soke abu. Sabo a 1.7.
features.p17: Karatu kawai, ta shiga da ke zama a na'urarka. Ana kashe shi gaba ɗaya da /airgapped on.

machines.p02: Duka suna da guntu ɗaya, ƙwaƙwalwa ɗaya ta 128 GB da na'urar sarrafawa da zane-zane ke raba, da DGX OS 7, don haka mai shigarwa ɗaya ya isa ga duka. Muna ginawa da gwada Mightling kowace rana a ASUS Ascent GX10. Sauran gwaje-gwajenmu na atomatik suna rufe su, amma ba ma gudanar da su da hannu.
paper.h302: Architecting Local, Air-Gap-Capable Desktop Clients for Agentic AI Pair Programmers: Protocol Compatibility, Process Isolation, and Host Memory Safety
paper.p04: Muna bayyana ƙirar Mightling Desktop, shirin tebur na buɗaɗɗen tushe. Muna ba da jerin ƙa'ida na abin da zai iya yi da wanda ba zai iya ba, kuma muna auna shi. Yana magana da ƙa'idar app-server iri ɗaya da abokin ciniki na tebur na mai samar da asali, yana riƙe saitunan asali iri ɗaya da Codex, yana gudanar da samfurin a kayan aikin mai amfani da kansa, kuma yana tsayar da kowane umarni na sandbox a wurin aiki idan mai amfani ya rubuta /airgapped on.
faq.p03: Eh, don gudanar da samfurin. Sauran kwamfutocinka abokan ciniki ne da ke aronsa: Linux (Arm ko x86) da macOS da umarnin shigarwa iri ɗaya, da Windows (Arm ko x86, samfurin gwaji) da layin PowerShell.
faq.summary04: Na shigar da Puffin. Wannan shiri ɗaya ne?
faq.p05: Eh. An canza sunan Puffin zuwa Mightling a 1.5. Gudanar da puffin update sau ɗaya, sannan ka gudanar da puffin sau na ƙarshe. Yana kai zamanka, saitunanka da hanyoyin haɗinka, kuma bayan haka umarnin shi ne ling.
faq.summary06: Da gaske ba ya kashe kuɗi?
faq.p07: Babu kuɗi don shirin, babu kuma don samfurin. Mightling buɗaɗɗen tushe ne ƙarƙashin AGPL, kuma nauyin samfurin kyauta ne a yi amfani da shi. Kana biyan na'urar da wutar lantarkin da take ci.
faq.summary08: Me nake buƙata baya ga na'urar?
faq.p09: Tsarin aiki da ke zuwa tare da ita (DGX OS 7, ko Ubuntu 24.04 a inda NVIDIA ke bayarwa), Docker da NVIDIA Container Toolkit, Python 3 da Git. A Ubuntu na yau da kullum, ling-admin host check yana gaya maka abin da ya rasa.
faq.summary10: Shin wani abu yana fita zuwa intanet ko da yaushe?
faq.p11: Abin da kai ko mai taimakon ya nema kawai, kamar binciken yanar gizo (ta SearXNG da ke aiki a na'urarka) da saukarwa a karon farko. Da /airgapped on, duka an kashe su.
faq.p13: Qwen3.8-27B, a tsarin 4-bit na NVIDIA mai suna NVFP4, SGLang ke bayarwa tare da ƙaramin mataimaki mai hasashe mai suna DFlash2 drafter. Mun zaɓa mun kuma gyara duka don GB10. Nauyin yana ɗaukar kusan 20 GB, kuma yayin da yake aiki, kusan 38 GB na ƙwaƙwalwar na'urar yana nan a wofi.
cta.h201: Ka riƙe lambarka a kan teburinka
cta.p02: Idan kana ganin lambar kwamfuta ta zauna a kan teburin da aka rubuta ta, ba wa ma'ajiyar tauraro a GitHub. Haka sauran masu GB10 ke samun Mightling.
footer.p01: Mightling na Dreamference. Dreamference tana gina AI na sirri da ke aiki a kayan aikinka.
footer.p02: Buɗaɗɗen tushe ƙarƙashin GNU AGPL v3. NVIDIA, GB10, DGX da DGX Spark alamun kasuwanci ne na NVIDIA Corporation; sauran sunaye alamun kasuwanci ne na masu su. Mightling da Dreamference ba su da alaƙa da su.
footer.p03: Wannan shafi ba ya neman komai daga wani shafi: babu masu bin diddigi, babu ƙidaya maziyarta, babu rubutu daga wani wuri.
mock.s4: Rufe hanyoyin host a cikin bwrap
mock.user: Gwajin yin rajista yana faɗuwa idan imel ɗin wofi ne. Gano dalili, ka gyara.
mock.agent: Rubutu mai sarari kawai ya wuce binciken, domin binciken ya gudana kafin a cire sarari. Yanzu ina cire sarari tukuna, a src/auth/signup.py, kuma na ƙara gwaji don ya tsaya a gyare.
new.c1_h3: Injin ling-serve, ScaleSearch drafter, da Forgejo a kowane node
new.c1_p: ling-serve na zaɓi yana gudanar da Qwen3.8-27B a GB10 da ƙwaƙwalwar token 262K. Kowane node yana samun Forgejo na sirri nasa (wurin ajiye ma'ajiyar git), kuma Telegram Mini App yana aiki kai tsaye a kan ma'ajiyarka.
new.c2_h3: An rufe socket na mai masaukin baki, ma'ajin fayiloli na gida, da LoRA adapters
new.c2_p: A cikin sandbox na umarni, socket na Docker, containerd, D-Bus da systemd an rufe su (socket ƙofa ce da shiri zai iya amfani da ita don ba tsarin umarni). ling-docs yanzu yana karanta shafukan da aka duba da takardun ofis, kuma uwar garken na iya samar da LoRA adapters masu sa hannu (ƙananan ƙari ga samfurin).
new.c3_h3: Manhajar tebur a macOS, Linux da Windows, da Night Shift best-of-N
new.c3_p: Ask da Work suna raba taga ɗaya ta tebur, da faifan dubawa, worktrees da shafukan tasha. /night add --best-of N yana gudanar da aiki sau N ya riƙe mafi kyawun gwaji.
surfaces.r3_p: Za ka iya haɗa JetBrains ko VS Code ta stdio MCP (ling-admin mcp). Za ka kuma iya aika saƙonni zuwa GB10 naka daga Signal (zuwa kanka, a Note to Self), daga Telegram (da Mini App na aiki a kan ma'ajiya), da kuma daga Matrix ta Tailscale. Kowane haɗin waya a kashe yake har sai ka kunna shi. Signal yana da ɓoyewa daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe, kuma Matrix yana aiki a uwar garken naka. Saƙonnin Telegram suna wucewa ta sabobin Telegram ba tare da ɓoyewa ba, don haka yi amfani da shi kawai don abubuwan da ba za ka damu a raba ta wannan hanya ba.
resources.c2_p: Yadda za a mayar da GB10 amintacce don loda, yadda ake fara uwar garken samfurin, yadda ake haɗa kwamfutocin Mac, Linux da Windows da shi, da yadda ake gudanar da binciken egress.
resources.c3_p: Daidaita samfurin item-response na Rasch da kanka ka sake samun kowace lamba ta kowace matsala a tebur ɗin ma'auni daga bayanan gwaje-gwajen SWE-bench na jama'a.
